name: @planpal/recurrence
description: Server-side recurrence engine (Phase 4 kickoff) — expands master-rule + exception events into concrete occurrences over a date range. The client never expands rules.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="**/*.test.js" --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=90 dist/timezone.test.js dist/rrule.test.js dist/expand.test.js dist/row.test.js
